purpose: Select one exact Campaign069 historical-only profit-growth-versus-ROE transition candidate after the Campaign068 cold-start rejection and before reading any Campaign069 source row, candidate value, comparison value, daily price, or forward return.

definition_only_inventory.numeric_order_rule: Use compact-cache v4's exact 98-factor logical order and append terminal Campaign068/higher exactly once; retain Campaign063 only as the frozen structurally nonnumeric definition in the complete order.

finite_candidate_design_catalog.reason: The fixed rank gap asks whether already-public profit growth is high relative to current ROE, representing a growth-to-profitability transition rather than a current quality level, three-field balance, profit scale, or growth acceleration. It uses only same-report levels and therefore avoids Campaign068's multi-year differencing cold start.
Testing both signs would be an inversion search. Campaign069 freezes profit_yoy rank minus ROE rank and direction higher from the economic hypothesis.
Both direct level definitions are already exposed as quality_profit and quality_roe in the terminal library.

The fields have unlike units and denominator/sign instability. Selecting among multiple transforms would create an unregistered transform search; only separate cross-sectional ranks and one fixed difference are allowed.
Adding a third component would reopen component and operator selection already explored by Campaign066-Campaign068.
No threshold, filter, subset, board, year, size, regime, minute interaction, fitted weight, or model is searched.

selected_candidate.name: quarterly_profit_growth_roe_transition_gap_2r
selected_candidate.economic_hypothesis: A firm whose already-public profit YoY growth ranks above its current ROE rank may be in an improving profitability transition not yet fully reflected over the next three sessions.
selected_candidate.formula: At each stock day, attach the latest separately available roe and profit_yoy states from disclosures effective strictly before the signal; on the exact common finite two-field stock-day cross-section compute average-tie percentile ranks r_profit_yoy and r_roe, then return r_profit_yoy-r_roe.
selected_candidate.availability_rule: Each report becomes usable only on the first accepted local session strictly after announcement_date.
selected_candidate.same_effective_date_rule: Sort by instrument, effective session, report_date, and announcement_date, then keep the last row per instrument and effective session.
selected_candidate.state_rule: Forward-fill roe and profit_yoy independently inside each instrument after strict effective-session ordering; never backfill from a later disclosure.
selected_candidate.cross_section_rule: On each stock day require both fields finite and use pandas-compatible average-tie percentile ranks on the exact common two-field identity cross-section.
selected_candidate.combination_rule: Exactly r_profit_yoy minus r_roe; coefficients are fixed at +1 and -1 and are not fitted.
selected_candidate.missing_rule: Missing unless both already-effective states and both ranks are finite. Never impute, clip, winsorize, substitute, backfill, or choose a favorable report.

campaign068_failure_informed_design_cons.lesson: A high steady-state median coverage does not rescue a structurally empty early-history tail under a frozen P05 gate.
campaign068_failure_informed_design_cons.applied_constraint: Campaign069 uses same-report states already present in the source and does not require a prior-year or prior-quarter observation.

decision.next_action: Perform a complete 100-definition mechanism-overlap audit, then freeze the 99-comparator coverage-first protocol and exact comparator-source split before reading source or candidate values.
